g.text: A selected policy that completes the fixed track
Deterministic tanh(mean) · Unity seed 7 · n=3 repeated episodes per start · 120 s cap
Time = decisions × 0.1 s (terminal interval can overestimate by ≈0.08 s). Finish is inferred from terminal reward.
Approach starts shorten the route; they are not held-out tracks. No independent training-seed or generalization result.
